historicalOriginalTexts.originalText: AC6-01-A: An outside caster uses an actual rank5 multi-target spell against one creature inside the globe and one outside. Only the inside recipient's new application is blocked. The paid RP, cadence and concentration remain committed. A rank6 spell is not reduced to rank5 because its caster received an RP discount, and a surcharge on rank5 does not let it bypass the globe.

AC6-01-B: A creature walks into the globe with an existing low-rank buff and an existing curse; both retain their source procedures. An externally anchored low-rank damage field has its covered local expression blocked, without losing its outside portion or pausing expiry. A genuinely inside-origin spell can still affect inside targets. Ending the globe does not discharge all missed periodic damage at once.

AC6-02-A: The ward encloses two closed real doors and no third eligible closure. Both receive the closure layer; the visual veil and entry-watch layer still exist. A recognized ally must still handle a genuine underlying mundane lock. An unrecognized creature spends an Action and succeeds at the ward task against DC16; that opening is allowed, but the ward remains for a later closing.

AC6-02-B: An unrecognized foe enters, receives the six-second outline, exits and is pushed back inside in the same numbered round. No second outline duration or damage appears. The marker can show its actual position through this ward's veil, but does not reveal a creature through stone or create a remote identity report. Removing the single parent spell ends all three defensive constituents.

AC6-03-A: The caster selects Lawful Evil and Chaotic Evil as two complete pairs. One creature has actual Lawful Evil recorded and makes WIS; a 3d8 result of17 becomes8 on success before defenses. Another has an unknown moral axis and is not assigned Evil merely because it attacks the party. No alignment roster or failed-eligibility explanation is returned to the caster.

AC6-03-B: A matching creature enters two overlapping Forbiddance fields. Its one named-family opportunity is resolved from the earliest eligible source; being pushed out/back cannot produce a second opportunity that round. An actual later alignment overlay can change future eligibility, but does not retroactively undo prior damage or trigger damage immediately without a new START/entry event.

AC6-04-A: With its creator's actual permission, a mobile concentration field is sealed at its current origin. The field can no longer move but still needs its original caster's concentration and ends on its original minute deadline. The seven-day Seal therefore ends with it. An attempt to protect the whole caster or freeze a creature-attached buff in space is ineligible under this explicitly proposed target rule.

AC6-04-B: The Seal is suppressed while its still-live parent moves lawfully to a new origin. On resumption before the original deadline, the proposed anchor fixes that current position; it does not teleport the field back or restart seven days. A new paid Seal can replace the caster's old Seal but cannot target another Seal/Anchor to build an unlimited protection loop. Those cross-family choices await joint review.

AC6-06-A: A willing creature has three ordinary Corrupted sources and one major removable Corruption application. All four end in one purge, rather than only one minor record. Its actual Wound, spent RP and Unity Exposure track remain. A separate intrinsic Oracle burden does not become a removable corruption record merely because the player dislikes its effects.

AC6-06-B: Area mode intersects two ordinary divisible environmental Corruption fields and encloses an unwilling creature. The eligible intersections are removed while their outside extents remain. The creature succeeds on CON and resists this cast's removal on itself. An actual uniquely protected engine still requiring its named cure is not destroyed through a clipped corner, and no hidden list of surviving sources is reported.

AC6-07-A: Two arrows would hit the pet after their attack rolls. Their separate d2 results are1 and2: the first direct impact becomes a Miss with no on-hit rider, while the second retains its real hit and damage. A third arrow that already missed rolls no d2. A nearby area explosion remains an area effect and receives no projectile miss chance merely because its carrier was a thrown object.

AC6-07-B: One magical missile has lightning and necrotic components in a single direct impact. Its one d2 result controls that impact and both hit-dependent components; it does not get another50% attempt for each type. A commanded wind slash makes one2d8 slashing attack, not the lower pet's two attacks. Full suppression ends this proposed body without preserving a fresh65HP return.

AC6-08-A: The caster and an actual ally inside10feet with line of effect qualify. A17fire component becomes8 through one resistance step, while a separate9necrotic component keeps its own ordinary defenses. Two overlapping fields do not turn the fire component into4. The spell applies the full five-type elemental set rather than silently choosing fire only.

AC6-08-B: An ally moves outside the aura before its next incoming lightning packet and gets no lingering field resistance. Another ally receives a post-defense damage-transfer branch while inside; the reviewed transfer procedure forbids a second mitigation step, so this aura does not halve that branch again. Actual concentration loss ends the moving field without storing unused resistance.

AC6-09-A: After the first target, the Director's stable candidate order contains three creatures, including one ally. A fair1d3 result2 selects that ally; the caster cannot replace it after seeing the roll. Later the chain reaches a creature with no unvisited legal successor and stops at four total bodies. A shared3d8 result19 becomes9 on each successful DEX save before defenses.

AC6-09-B: All six distinct targets are selected before damage. The first is lightning-immune and the second dies from its packet, but neither event erases later established arcs. A large target cannot be selected twice through two occupied squares. Six bodies in a straight maximum-length chain could extend60+5×30=210feet from the caster only if every actual30foot hop has legal line of effect.

AC6-10-A: The caster uses its real BA to command the newly formed Skybrand and has the shared offensive allowance available. In the attached phase it moves20feet, makes one1d12lightning attack, then uses its remaining10feet before the second attack. Both attacks belong to one commanded offensive activation. The owner's other companion cannot take another offensive Action because the blade only used part of its movement.

AC6-10-B: The first attack misses and the declared second target has become invalid before execution. The second attack is lost; no third target or refunded allowance appears. Next round the caster needs a new legal BA command. A temporary suppression that covers execution supplies no banked pair of attacks on resumption, and ending the spell leaves no equipable weapon.

AC6-12-A: An otherwise legal eligible metalwork order has120adjusted active manufacturing minutes remaining after all real time modifiers. Two complete ten-minute forge cycles require10additional protectedRP and20actual work minutes, crediting120minutes once. The forge's initial13RP is separate. The lead still needs actual formula/training/tools/materials and makes the ordinary final batch check; neither the credited work nor the RP guarantees a product.

AC6-12-B: A cycle is interrupted after six actual minutes. Its5RP and six minutes remain spent, but it grants no partial sixty-minute credit. Earlier progress follows the order's real phase rules and inputs keep aging. If a later final cycle has only15minutes of work remaining, it still costs5RP/ten actual minutes and credits15only; no45-minute remainder transfers to another order. A real successful product persists after the forge vanishes.

AC6-13-A: An actual allied faction qualifies and the caster rolls3d6=12. Only nine of the originally declared formation spaces remain legal, so nine distinct soldiers form and three rolled arrivals are lost. Each has its own HP/position. One paid BA command directs one soldier's attack in the shared attached phase; the other eight may move defensively/Dodge, not make eight additional free attacks.

AC6-13-B: A soldier carrying a genuinely supplied pack reaches0HP. Its manifestation and intrinsic weapon vanish, while the actual pack drops at its real position. No named faction member loses HP elsewhere and no harvested corpse appears. Ending concentration removes the remaining cohort without adding faction reputation, returning borrowed people or filling permanent expedition offices.

cases.title: Nexus source-specific teleport classification against Paladin predicates
cases.initialState: Live Conjuration8 Nexus gateway. Three independent targets each stand at origin mouth: A under No Escape, B under Verdict Absolute, C under Reign of Ashes. Each considers voluntary crossing; all bodies fit and endpoints otherwise legal.
